text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to learn. This data includes examples with correct answers. The computer builds a model from these examples. Later, the model can make predictions about new data it has never seen before. For instance, it can predict if an email is spam or not. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model learned. A good model makes correct predictions most of the time. This simple idea powers many smart systems we use every day.
